description: Source code for ATM driver core functions specific to VR9 platform, including hardware reset, firmware download, and initialization routines.

methods.name: vr9_reset_ppe
methods.description: Performs reset sequence for PPE hardware components.

methods.name: vr9_pp32_download_code
methods.description: Downloads firmware code and data to the PP32 processor.

methods.name: vr9_init

methods.name: vr9_stop
methods.description: Stops the firmware execution on PP32.
